This is the right bulk-management approach. “Select all” must mean every link matching the current view, search, and tag filters—even when only one page of results is visible. I’d label it **“Select all N matching”** rather than “shown,” so that scope is unmistakable.

The add-tag box should offer my existing tags as I type, just like the tag field when saving. The remove-tag menu is a good choice.

Selection can remain after changes that leave the selected links visible, such as adding or removing a tag. If an action moves them out of the current view—marking items read while I’m in To read, or archiving them—the selection should clear rather than leaving invisible items selected. Bulk deletion only from Archived, with confirmation, remains the right safeguard.
